blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abu Sa'id ibn Abi Fadalah Ansari (RA)
blocks.tamil_translation: For, in the matter of partnership, Allah Ta'ala is far more free of need than all partners,” an announcer will proclaim.” Hazrat Abu Sa'id ibn Abi Fadalah Ansari (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of “In the matter of partnership, Allah Ta'ala is far more free of need than the partnership of all partners” is that, just as others accept others being partners with them, Allah never likes anyone being a partner with Allah Ta'ala.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ عِلْمًا لِغَيْرِ اللهِ اَوْ اَرَادَ بِهِ غَيْرَ اللهِ فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال هذا حديث حسن غريب، باب في من يطلب بعلمه الدنيا، رقم:٢٦٥٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a person learns the knowledge of Deen for a purpose other than the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala (to gain honour, fame, wealth and the like), let him make his abode in Jahannam.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: تَعَوَّذُوْا بِاللهِ مِنْ جُبِّ الْحَزَنِ قَالُوْا: يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ! وَمَا جُبُّ الْحَزَنِ؟ قَالَ: وَادٍ فِيْ جَهَنَّمَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْهُ جَهَنَّمُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ قِيْلَ: يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ! وَمَنْ يَدْخُلُهُ؟ قَالَ: اَلْقُرَّاءُ الْمُرَاؤُوْنَ بِاَعْمَالِهِمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب، باب ما جاء في الرياء والسمعة، رقم:٢٣٨٣
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Seek protection from Jubb-ul-Hazan,” the Sahabah (RA) asked, Jubb-ul-Hazan” — what is it?” Rasulullah ﷺ said, ”It is a valley in Jahannam; Jahannam itself seeks protection from that valley a hundred times every day.” “Ya Rasulallah,
